stem: What is the range of the function \( f(x) = -x^2 + 60x \)?

options.label: A
options.text: All real numbers that are greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 30

options.label: B
options.text: All real numbers that are greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 60

options.label: C
options.text: All real numbers that are greater than or equal to 900

options.label: D
